## `Core/Physics/Collision/Collision.h`

- `struct CollisionContact` — How two overlapping shapes meet.
- `CollisionContact`: `Float2 normal` — Unit vector from A towards B

- `CollisionContact`: `Float2 point` — The deepest point of contact
- `struct CastHit` — Where a moving shape or a ray first touches something.
- `CastHit`: `Float2 point`
- `CastHit`: `Float2 normal` — Faces the mover; zero when it started inside (fraction 0)
- `CastHit`: `float fraction = 0.0f` — 0..1 along the movement; the mover stops a hair before the surface
